solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cuckoo flying sees L Ness

indicators.note: flying apart suggests these letters scatter and land in a new order

explanation.surface: A birdwatcher reports a cuckoo flying past, having spotted the Loch Ness monster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying' rearranges SEESLNESS. 'Cuckoo' looks like the bird in the scene but is the adjective meaning mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Cuckoo is informal for crazy, and a senseless act or person is foolish, lacking any reason.

clue.text: Self-satisfied son, gullible chap

parts.note: a mug is slang for a dupe, someone easily fooled

explanation.surface: A father describes his son as smug and easily taken in.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone pleased with themselves to an irritating degree is complacent and self-satisfied.

clue.text: Some flirt so naughtily lifting part of body

indicators.note: in a down clue, lifting raises the letters so they read from bottom to top
only some of the letters of these words are used, a run hidden across them

explanation.surface: A flirtatious person behaves so naughtily that something is lifted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Some' hides LIRTSON across 'flirt so naughtily'; 'lifting' turns it upwards in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Each opening of the nose is an anatomical feature, a small part of the human body.

clue.text: In French article, presenting girl

parts.note: the French word for in is en
A is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A French newspaper article features a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ena is a female first name, so it is an example of a girl's name.

clue.text: Book three's complicated

indicators.note: something complicated is tangled up, so these letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A remark that a threesome is always complicated.
explanation.definitionFit: Esther is one of the books of the Old Testament in the Bible.

clue.text: American visiting country left large Cornish town

indicators.note: a visitor goes into a place, so one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: a state is a nation or country
US abbreviates United States, i.e. American
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: An American tourist leaves a big Cornish town after visiting the country.
explanation.walkthrough: ST AUSTELL is a town in Cornwall, the county at England's south-west tip.
explanation.definitionFit: St Austell is a well-known town in Cornwall, famous for china clay, so it fits the description.

clue.text: Bath for one son, given by father

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A boy is given a bath by his dad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bath' looks like a tub but stands for the English city, famous for its Roman baths; 'for one' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Bath is an English city built around mineral springs, so it is an example of a health resort town.

clue.text: Take sixteen to Paris

definitions.meaning: to take hold of or grab something forcibly
the French word for the number sixteen, as a Parisian would say it

explanation.surface: An instruction to take sixteen people on a trip to Paris.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking is grabbing hold of something, and the French number sixteen is written with the same letters.

clue.text: Song about chaps in a foreign land

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece is wrapped round the other

parts.note: an aria is a song in an opera
chaps are men

explanation.surface: A song about some fellows abroad in another country.
explanation.definitionFit: Armenia is a country in the Caucasus, a foreign nation to the British setter.

clue.text: Parvenu's good times with prostitute

definitions.note: read as parvenu is: a newcomer who has risen socially

parts.note: ups, as in ups and downs, are good periods
tart is slang for a prostitute

explanation.surface: A social climber is having a great time in the company of a call girl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Parvenu's' stands for 'parvenu is', so the definition is the noun and the 's is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a parvenu is a person newly risen in wealth or status, a social climber resented by others.

clue.text: Man after a kiss in principle

indicators.note: after places one piece following the others

parts.note: X is the cross used to represent a kiss
IOM is the abbreviation for the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: A man pursues a kiss as a matter of principle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is not a chap but the Isle of Man, abbreviated IOM.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an axiom is a self-evident truth or basic rule accepted as a starting point.

clue.text: Tanner's knife fashioned a work of horror

indicators.note: something fashioned is shaped or made anew, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A leatherworker's blade is made into a horror story.
explanation.definitionFit: Mary Shelley's novel about a scientist and his monster is a classic Gothic horror story.

clue.text: Phone's yet to be adapted for novices

indicators.note: adapting changes something's form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mobile phone still needs adapting for beginners to use it.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: neophytes are beginners or newcomers to a subject or activity.

clue.text: Disney: no flipping composer!

parts.note: Walt Disney, the animator and film producer

indicators.note: flipping turns the word no over so it reads backwards

explanation.surface: An exasperated cry that a Disney composer will not do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' looks like a mild curse but reverses NO to ON.
explanation.definitionFit: William Walton was an English composer of the twentieth century, known for Belshazzar's Feast.

clue.text: Rapacious noise from cow upset sea creature

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the word upside down so it reads bottom to top

parts.note: to low is to moo, the sound a cow makes
a fish is a creature of the sea

explanation.surface: A cow's moo disturbs a marine animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone greedy and predatory is like a hungry wolf, ravenous and grasping.

clue.text: Lake some have negotiated coming west

indicators.note: in an across entry, going west means reading right to left
only some of the letters of these words are used, a run hidden across them

explanation.surface: A lake that some have negotiated while travelling westward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' hides AVENEG in 'have negotiated'; 'coming west' reverses it in this across entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Lac Léman, on the Swiss-French border, is known in English as Lake Geneva after the city.

clue.text: Bees flying about on island's trees

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round the other
flying about scatters these letters into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
I is the abbreviation for island; the 's is joining

explanation.surface: Bees buzz about trees on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying' and 'about' both look like the bees' movement; the first jumbles them to EBES, the second wraps that round the island piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Ebony is a tropical hardwood tree with dark timber, so these are several such trees.

clue.text: Preserve of English doctor, endless charity

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification

indicators.note: endless means the final letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: alms are charitable gifts to the poor

explanation.surface: A preserve made by an English doctor, given away in endless charity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims ALMS to ALM. 'Preserve' looks like a noun (jam) but is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: embalming a body is treating it with chemicals so that it does not decay.

clue.text: Admiral's mistress and boy meeting YHA poet

parts.note: a lad is a boy
John Milton, author of Paradise Lost

explanation.surface: A lover of a naval officer and a youth meet a poet at a youth hostel.
explanation.walkthrough: YHA is the Youth Hostels Association, a British network of budget hostels.
explanation.definitionFit: Emma Hamilton was famously the lover of Admiral Lord Nelson during the Napoleonic wars.

clue.text: Good-looking girl, timid

parts.note: Di is a girl's name, short for Diana
shy means timid

explanation.surface: A description of a woman as attractive but timid.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishy is informal British slang for attractive, especially said of a person.

clue.text: Caribbean islands: Skye is quite different

indicators.note: being quite different means the letters take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A comparison: tropical islands are nothing like the Scottish island of Skye.
explanation.definitionFit: Cays or keys are low coral islands, like the Florida Keys bordering the Caribbean.

clue.text: At home, prepared small picture?

parts.note: in means at home
set means ready or prepared

explanation.surface: A small framed picture is set up at home.
explanation.definitionFit: An inset is a small image placed within a larger one, such as a detail map on a page.

clue.text: A very loud tune ending in fine fling

parts.note: ff, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud
an air is a tune

indicators.note: the ending of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A loud tune marks the end of a fine romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an affaire is a brief love affair, a passing romantic fling.

clue.text: Nightingale's familiar form, fairly like owl initially

indicators.note: initially means taking the first letter of each of these words

explanation.surface: A nightingale's shape is rather like an owl's.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nightingale' is not the bird but Florence Nightingale, the Victorian nursing pioneer.
explanation.definitionFit: Florence's friendly short name is a pet form or nickname of her given name.

clue.text: Conclusion of research, indeed, something cut and dried

indicators.note: the conclusion of a word is its last letter

parts.note: ay is an old word for yes, indeed

explanation.surface: The result of the research is, indeed, already settled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut and dried' reads as settled, but literally describes grass mown and dried.
explanation.definitionFit: Grass is mown and dried to make fodder for livestock, literally cut and dried.

clue.text: SMS menu, so confused, displaying calls

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so these letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A muddled text-message menu showing incoming calls.
explanation.definitionFit: Summonses are official demands to attend, such as a court order, so formal calls.
